dataPolicy: Synthetic Local data; no credentials, cookies, tokens or secret URLs retained.

routes.keyboardSequence: Tab to Email; type synthetic account; Tab to Forgot password; Tab to Password; type existing local credential; Tab to Sign in; Enter.
routes.activationResult: Projects page rendered after successful sign-in.

routes.keyboardSequence: Reload; Tab reveals skip link; Enter moves focus to main; Tab focuses New import; Tab focuses Search projects; type unmatched synthetic query; Tab to Search; Enter; activate Clear search and filters with Enter.

limitations: Sorting, pagination and every bulk action have not been exercised in a continuous keyboard sequence.

routes.keyboardSequence: Enter on New import; choose a synthetic invalid file through the file chooser; Tab from file input to Check spreadsheet; Enter.

routes.keyboardSequence: Enter on section anchor; Tab to disclosure; Enter expands; Enter collapses; Enter on Edit project information; Enter on Disciplines; type Virtual; Escape; save temporary synthetic summary and restore it.
routes.activationResult: Disclosure expanded and collapsed; search reduced options from 8 to 1; summary saved and then restored.
routes.focusRestoration: Escape returned focus to Disciplines trigger.
limitations: Not every review, media or publication action was exercised.

routes.keyboardSequence: Tab reveals Skip link; Tab to document link; Tab to Confirm project details; Tab to Request corrections summary; Space activates disclosure to expand; Tab focuses textarea#correction-comment with visible 3px focus outline; Tab focuses Submit correction request button; Shift+Tab reverses focus backwards without keyboard trap.
routes.activationResult: Space key toggles disclosure open and closed. Submit button on empty required textarea triggers HTML5 constraint validation bubble ('Please fill out this field.'). Reverse Tab sequence traverses backwards through DOM cleanly.
routes.focusRestoration: Shift+Tab restores focus cleanly back through textarea, summary, confirm button, document link, and skip link.
limitations: Safe validation failure triggered without submitting a persistent correction record to preserve project review state.
